description: No clean concept found. The unit fires somewhat more often in open positions (no full column, two or more empty columns, centre column not tall), but the firing depends nonlinearly on exact stone placement; single-stone changes swing it across the threshold, and no threat, height, centre-control or last-move pattern explains it.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.04 (once 0.11 on column 3).
notes: Tried open-board (p1: F1 0.098, AUROC 0.61, sim 0.02), early-game points (F1 0.065, AUROC 0.52), deep-well (F1 0.071, AUROC 0.54). Histograms of heights, cell occupancy, threat counts, elevated threats, centre control, ply, last move: only weak trends (firing is slightly earlier, fewer full columns). Activation is order-invariant but very sensitive to single stones. 4-stone minimal pairs: my stones on columns 0 and 6 with theirs on 2 and 5 give about 2; any of my stones in the centre drops it below 0, but this does not generalise to mid-games. Likely a random direction or a polysemantic mixture. Synthesis reaches 3.39 against a dev max of 2.87.
